<description>
Expose individual functional tests through the same CTest interface used for unit tests, making them easier to select, inspect, and rerun from the command line or CTest-aware IDEs.

Scheduling unit and functional tests together may improve parallel execution. It also enables per-test results and timings to be uploaded to our [Bitcoin Core CDash instance](https://my.cdash.org/index.php?project=bitcoin-core), helping track failures and runtime changes across builds.

Registration is opt-in with `BUILD_FUNCTIONAL_TESTS=ON` and requires CMake 4.4 or newer. The existing runner remains available for RPC coverage and CSV results. The native macOS CI job exercises the combined CTest workflow and passes. See `test/README.md` for usage and limitations.
</description>

[2026-10-25] r:5641220472 review COMMENTED by BrandonOdiwuor (contributor):
Tested ACK f5741987366395a11dd57c518bf4098251d8b805

An opt-in way to run the functional tests through CTest is valuable for developers integrating Bitcoin Core into CMake/CTest/CDash workflows, and for anyone who wants finer-grained control (filtering, parallel scheduling, fixtures, dashboard reporting) while  replacing the existing `test_runner.py` unchanged.

Tested on Ubuntu 24.04 with CMake 4.4.2.

### Build and discovery

- Clean configure/build with -DBUILD_FUNCTIONAL_TESTS=ON.
- Discovery: 307 base functional tests registered; 311 with TEST_RUNNER_EXTRA='--extended'.
- Label and regex filtering (-L, -LE, -R) work as expected.

Build and discovery logs:

[build-and-discovery.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33917679/build-and-discovery.txt)

### Execution

- Individual tests and small mixed sets run successfully under CTest.
- Full wallet suite (76 tests) passed under -j4, with the expected skips for tests that require previous-release binaries.
- Parallel scheduling, UUID-suffixed temporary directories, and PYTHON_GIL=1 work as intended.
- Legacy test_runner.py path remains unaffected.
- --rerun-failed correctly re-runs only previously failed tests and respects the fixture setup.

Execution logs:

[ctest logs.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33917685/ctest.logs.txt)

### Cache fixture behavior

- Fixture order is correct: functional.cache_remove_before → functional.create_cache → real tests → functional.cache_remove_after.
- Cache directory is created under the build tree and cleaned up afterward.
- Consecutive runs both succeed (cache is recreated each time).
- Manual deletion of the cache mid-suite (after tests had already started) did not break the in-progress tests. The subsequent run recovered cleanly.

Cache logs;

[cache-fixture-runs.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33917697/cache-fixture-runs.txt)

### CDash submission
Submitted functional test runs to a local CDash instance (Experimental track) via a dashboard script. Results appear correctly with the functional label.

- Fixtures and individual tests are reported as expected.
- Expected skips surface as Not Run; failures are reported correctly.
- Remote submission: https://my.cdash.org/builds/4365061

### Notes

- The CMake ≥ 4.4 requirement is correctly enforced (needed for discover_tests()).
- Extended tests are properly gated behind TEST_RUNNER_EXTRA='--extended' at discovery time.
- Skip semantics (exit 77) are handled correctly by CTest.
</new_statements>
